arguments.summary: Company contribution: conditional annual GAAP EPS/multiple sensitivities are usable for NVDA and MU, anchored to reported interim results and management outlooks, but they are not fair-value estimates or probabilities. QQQ provides diversified but material dated overlap with both issuers; its sponsor aggregate P/E is not methodologically interchangeable with either company’s hypothetical scenario P/E.

claims.text: NVDA reported GAAP diluted EPS of $4.85 for the first six months of FY2027 (Jan. 26–Jul. 26, 2026). Its FY2027 is a 53-week year ending Jan. 31, 2027, with a 14-week Q4. Q2 revenue was $96.2bn and Q3 revenue outlook was $108.0bn ±2%, explicitly assuming no China Data Center compute revenue. These are the operating anchors for the H2 sensitivity, not EPS guidance.

NVDA’s annual GAAP scenarios use $8.50/$9.50/$10.50 EPS and 18x/24x/30x hypothetical P/E. Relative to the Sep. 18 close, bear/base/bull sensitivities are -31.16%/+2.58%/+41.72%. The implied H2 residuals are $3.65/$4.65/$5.65 under a constant diluted-share approximation, not an exact reconciliation: bear tests weaker AI-demand-to-margin conversion or supply/policy friction; base requires Q3 delivery and sustained demand; bull requires stronger execution into the 14-week Q4. Bull upside exceeds bear-loss magnitude by 10.55 percentage points, a grid property without probability or expected-return meaning.

At the NVDA dated close, the base $9.50 EPS assumption requires a 23.3968x P/E to equate scenario value with price; equivalently, holding 24x fixed, EPS must be $9.26125. Exceeding—not merely reaching—either held-fixed threshold is required for upside. Thus, delivery of the operational bridge alone may not suffice if the multiple contracts; reversal evidence would be a Q3 result/outlook that changes the H2 earnings bridge or evidence that changes the market’s multiple tolerance.

MU reported GAAP diluted EPS of $41.40 for the first nine months of FY2026. FY2026 is a 53-week year ending Sep. 3, with a 14-week Q4; the fiscal year had ended but had not yet been reported at the fixed evaluation date. Q3 GAAP EPS was $24.67 and management’s Q4 GAAP EPS outlook was $30.73 ±$1.00. Accordingly, the annual estimate is provisional historical completion, not a forward-growth forecast.

MU’s annual GAAP scenarios use $70/$72/$74 EPS and 10x/14x/18x hypothetical P/E. Relative to the Sep. 18 close, bear/base/bull sensitivities are -31.09%/-0.77%/+31.13%. The Q4 residuals are $28.60/$30.60/$32.60 under a constant diluted-share approximation: bear is below management’s $29.73–$31.73 GAAP guidance range and tests weaker memory pricing/mix, margins or trade/supply friction; base is within guidance; bull is above guidance and tests stronger pricing/mix and execution. Bull upside exceeds bear-loss magnitude by only 0.04 percentage points, effectively near-symmetric within this selected grid and not a cross-company ranking.

At the MU dated close, the base $72 EPS assumption requires a 14.1083x P/E to equate scenario value with price; equivalently, holding 14x fixed, EPS must be $72.5571. Exceeding either threshold, holding the other input fixed, is necessary for upside. The Sep. 30 fiscal-Q4 report is a direct observable test of the residual and subsequent memory-demand/margin bridge; it does not resolve whether any assumed multiple is fair.

QQQ’s dated Sep. 18 sponsor holdings included NVDA at 8.535228% and MU at 5.012336%; therefore QQQ has direct exposure to both company-specific earnings bridges while remaining a 101-equity-holding fund with reported equity coverage of 99.859505%. QQQ’s sponsor-reported aggregate P/E was 30.08 as of Aug. 31. That aggregate fund metric cannot establish a fair or comparable P/E for NVDA or MU scenario inputs because the company figures are analyst assumptions and methodologies differ.

gaps.description: No consensus estimates, observed company P/E, empirical multiple history, or probability weights are supplied. This prevents an unconditional fair-value or relative-valuation ranking, but does not invalidate the explicitly hypothetical sensitivity grids.

Actual future diluted shares can differ from the constant-share residual approximation in both annual bridges; MU FY2026 Q4/full-year results were pending at the fixed evaluation date. The MU grid is therefore a conditional provisional completion until reported results establish the actual annual EPS.

QQQ holdings and aggregate valuation are dated sponsor snapshots; they are not current holdings, personalized exposure, or a decomposition of fund sensitivity to NVDA and MU. The excluded cash/futures positions and unknown-weight position further limit exact look-through.

assumptions: All company grid EPS and P/E inputs in e56/e57 are explicit annual US-GAAP, split-adjusted scenario assumptions—not consensus, current multiples, fair values, forecasts, or probability-weighted outcomes.
NVDA FY2027 bridge uses reported H1 EPS plus a constant-share H2 residual; management supplied revenue rather than EPS guidance and FY2027 includes a 14-week Q4.
MU FY2026 bridge uses reported nine-month EPS plus a constant-share Q4 residual; Q4 GAAP guidance is the stated earnings anchor, while the fiscal year was ended but unreported at the evaluation date.
QQQ comparison is limited to dated sponsor holdings and aggregate sponsor valuation; it is not a synthetic corporate-EPS valuation.
arguments.counter_thesis: AI-system demand may remain sufficiently strong for NVDA’s guided Q3 revenue and extended Q4 execution to support the higher H2 residual, while MU could deliver or exceed Q4 guidance through memory pricing/mix and operating leverage. Conversely, either company can meet its earnings bridge yet fail to produce price upside if the assumed P/E contracts; neither selected multiple band has empirical weighting here.

review_conditions.description: Review NVDA after the next reported quarter: update the H2 annual-EPS residual and scenario interpretation if reported revenue, margin, or outlook materially contradicts the $108.0bn ±2% Q3 revenue anchor or alters the no-China-compute assumption.

Review MU on the scheduled Sep. 30 fiscal-Q4 release: replace the provisional Q4 residual with reported GAAP EPS and reassess whether the result falls below, within, or above the $29.73–$31.73 guidance range; this changes the annual bridge but does not validate a P/E assumption.

shared_exposures.mechanism: QQQ’s Sep. 18 holdings directly include both NVDA and MU, so AI infrastructure demand, semiconductor supply/margin outcomes, and issuer-specific earnings surprises can transmit into the fund. This is dated composition only; weights are not current portfolio allocations and do not quantify price sensitivity.
shared_exposures.qualification: QQQ also contains numerous other equities and excluded non-equity positions; direct issuer exposure does not make QQQ equivalent to either single-stock scenario.
